description: Federal Reserve releases minutes from its latest policy meeting.
crypto_impact: Can trigger sharp volatility across BTC and ETH depending on the Fed's tone.
alphalens_view: Watch BTC, ETH, DXY and Gold immediately after the release.

description: Weekly report showing new unemployment benefit claims.
crypto_impact: Unexpected changes may briefly affect risk sentiment.
alphalens_view: Lower claims support USD strength while higher claims may support risk assets.

description: Monthly inflation report measuring consumer prices.
crypto_impact: Higher inflation may pressure crypto if markets expect tighter monetary policy.
alphalens_view: One of the most important macro events for BTC and ETH.

description: Measures inflation at the producer level.
crypto_impact: Can influence inflation expectations and market sentiment.
alphalens_view: Moderate impact unless there is a significant surprise.

description: European Central Bank monetary policy announcement.
crypto_impact: May influence EUR, USD and global risk appetite.
alphalens_view: Monitor BTC and ETH for increased volatility.

crypto_impact: Strong GDP can strengthen the USD and affect crypto sentiment.
alphalens_view: Watch for broad market reactions across crypto and equities.

crypto_impact: Often one of the biggest volatility drivers for financial markets.
alphalens_view: Expect elevated volatility in BTC, ETH and the US Dollar.
